noteID = ncForms.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) If InStr(flags, "r") > 0 Then framesets = framesets & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "W") > 0 Then pages = pages & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "U") > 0 Then subforms = subforms & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "O") > 0 Then outlines = outlines & " " & title & Chr(10) Else forms = forms & " " & title & Chr(10) End If noteID = ncForms.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FRAMESETS ===" & Chr(10) If framesets = "" Then out = out & " (not accessible via SelectForms - FS exists via launch settings)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & framesets out = out & Chr(10) & "=== PAGES ===" & Chr(10) If pages = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & pages out = out & Chr(10) & "=== OUTLINES ===" & Chr(10) If outlines = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & outlines out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via $Flags) ===" & Chr(10) If subforms = "" Then out = out & " (none via $Flags)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & subforms out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FORMS ===" & Chr(10) If forms = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & forms
'  ' 2. SUBFORMS via NotesForm API '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via NotesForm API) ===" & Chr(10) Dim sfNames(0) As String sfNames(0) = "Signature"
For i = 0 To 0 Set sf = db.GetForm(sfNames(i)) If Not sf Is Nothing Then out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & Chr(10) sfFields = sf.Fields For j = 0 To UBound(sfFields) out = out & " - " & sfFields(j) & Chr(10) Next j Else out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & " (not found - may be in template)" & Chr(10) End If Next i

ACL '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== ACCESS CONTROL LIST ===" & Chr(10) On Error Resume Next Set acl = db.ACL Set aclEntry = acl.GetFirstEntry() Do While Not aclEntry Is Nothing Select Case aclEntry.Level Case 0 : lvl = "No Access" Case 1 : lvl = "Depositor" Case 2 : lvl = "Reader" Case 3 : lvl = "Author" Case 4 : lvl = "Editor" Case 5 : lvl = "Designer" Case 6 : lvl = "Manager" End Select Select Case aclEntry.UserType Case 0 : entryType = "Unspecified" Case 1 : entryType = "Person" Case 2 : entryType = "Server" Case 3 : entryType = "Mixed Group" Case 4 : entryType = "Person Group" Case 5 : entryType = "Server Group" End Select out = out & " " & aclEntry.Name & " | " & lvl & " | " & entryType & Chr(10) Set aclEntry = acl.GetNextEntry(aclEntry) Loop On Error GoTo 0
